title: Rabbi Pilipi bar Nehorai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 71:9. When Rabbi Nehorai said Elijah was of Gad, Rabbi Pilipi bar Nehorai asked him, “What makes you say so?” It appears that it should read, “Rabbi Pilipi said to Rabbi Nehorai.”

notes.text: “Of Gad” is a tribal reference, not a parable. Hyman’s proposed correction changes “bar Nehorai” into a statement addressed to Nehorai.
The consulted Bereshit Rabbah names Pilipi bar Nehorai in the question to Nehorai. The change to an address without the patronymic is Hyman’s proposal.
